caption: The drawing depicts a brown, wrought-iron window grille with vertical and horizontal bars forming a grid pattern. The grille features decorative curl and scroll motifs at regular intervals on the intersections and edges, as well as a larger ornamental flourish at the top center. The structure has a slight outward curve, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain and off-white, with the artist's signature "W. Kieckhofel" appearing in small, black letters in the lower right section. The overall color palette is muted, with various shades of brown used for the ironwork, and no additional objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Iron Grille
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
